title: Highly toxic and toxic compressed gases—quantities exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area.
officialText: Ventilation exhaust shall be provided for highly toxic and toxic compressed gases in amounts exceeding the maximum allowable quantities per control area as required by Sections 502.9.8.1 through 502.9.8.6.
